dsa-v1-d09-height-and-size.alternative:
const treeSize=root=>{let size=0;const stack=root?[root]:[];while(stack.length){const node=stack.pop();size++;if(node.left)stack.push(node.left);if(node.right)stack.push(node.right);}return size;};
const treeHeight=root=>{let height=-1;const stack=root?[[root,0]]:[];while(stack.length){const [node,depth]=stack.pop();height=Math.max(height,depth);if(node.left)stack.push([node.left,depth+1]);if(node.right)stack.push([node.right,depth+1]);}return height;};
